correctness.rationale: Every pair of distinct noncentral vertices u,v gives adjacent center edges cu,cv with local resolving neighborhood exactly {u,v}. Thus all pair inequalities g(u)+g(v)>=1 are necessary, forcing noncentral total at least r. The half-weight outer assignment with center zero satisfies every remaining blade constraint with weight r-1/2. At total r the complete pair system has the unique solution one-half on every noncentral vertex, and the center must have weight zero. Direct LP reconstruction for r=2..8 confirms all neighborhood identities, values, and uniqueness.

value.rationale: The theorem evaluates a recently introduced local fractional invariant on a canonical windmill family for which the corresponding global fractional invariant was already important. It proves that localization leaves the optimum unchanged for every r>=2 and identifies the unique optimum, exposing a clean complete-pair LP obstruction rather than merely reproducing the global scalar value.
